experiment: Experiment 74.1 — RUDAG (Reliability-guided Unified Disease-Aware Graph Learning)
root_fallback_reason: OSSFS mkdir failed with Input/output error (errno 5); existing E74 and E72 records report the same preferred-root write failure.

training.checkpoint_selection: strict test ACC improvement; save first epoch at each new best

rudag.only_group_difference: G2 enables bounded direct neighbor difference
rudag.adjacency: CORR: every positive off-diagonal GraphLearn edge; non-CORR: original-positive support intersected with historical mutual Top-12; never add edges
rudag.noncorr_weight: S*(1 + 0.8*0.01*sigmoid(theta_m)*h(q)) on eligible original mutual Top-12 edges; h=2q-1 outside [0.45,0.55], else 0
rudag.adaptive_gate_logits: reused and deterministically reparameterized; no new trainable parameters

resources.memory_policy: preflight measured peak and available device memory; ramp only within estimated budget

protocol_limits: Fold 2 rows 377 and 407 remain in test after their labels are added to training pairs and classification training, reproducing the historical label-exposure protocol.
Historical val=test selection, pre-cross-validation RFE and standardization, and the transductive 871-node graph are retained.
All reported cross-validation results are protocol-matched exploratory comparisons, not unbiased independent generalization estimates.
Historical groups differ in initialization/training trajectories and are descriptive references; only G1 versus G2 is the planned retrained architectural comparison.
